title: Axiom Zen: launch release, 28 November 2017
supports: Public launch date, Axiom Zen developer attribution, Ethereum and ether, collecting and parent-trait breeding mechanic. The source subheading supplies the four-word phrase the power of fun. Marketing first-ever claims are not repeated.

title: CryptoKitties: fee update, 4 December 2017
supports: Contemporaneous developer account of congestion, slow transactions, increased gas prices and birthing fees; explains the software breeding process. Establishes December conditions separately from November launch.

title: Consensys: developer interviews, 20 February 2018
supports: First-person accounts from CryptoKitties, MetaMask, Infura and Grid+ contributors: pending queues, player confusion, collaboration, status indicators and resubmission improvements. Used for the congestion response, not the page introduction's imprecise launch dating.
